contract: Candidate schedule lifecycle: create an active fixed-interval schedule with an occurrence outside the bounded execution window. Pause it, assert a manual trigger is skipped without starting any workflow, resume it and manually trigger one real authored echo workflow. Preserve the original schedule identity, original trigger number, schedule-history/workflow-history relationship, generated workflow instance/run identities, exact Avro int64 action input and stored completed output. Delete the schedule after that workflow completes; HTTP triggering must return schedule_not_found and must not admit another workflow. Retain fresh original schedule history after deletion and assert adapter-specific deletion visibility rather than projecting it away. Verify the published HTTP and embedded representations before reviewing this candidate. Cron/timezone rules, overlap concurrency, backfill, missed fires, namespace/auth, multi-language directions and hard-kill recovery remain separate gates.
